# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This batch is a mixed bag. A genuine sales/dealer core does exist — enquiry, rate-quoting, cutting/length negotiation, payment-and-dispatch coordination calls with repeat buyers (Sridhar/Sivakesava Engineers, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Vidveda Krishnasamy, Venkatesan, VJR Developers, Vijayalakshmi Builder, Zetwork Harish, Vijaya Steels Vijayawada, Vasanth Narasimhan Engg, VR Earth Movers, etc.). However a very large share of the file is **not sales**: internal coil-cutting/production coordination with an operator ("Yuvraj Operator" series), personal/social Hindi-Tamil chit-chat (the long "Vishal" calls — family, cricket, market gossip, nothing commercial), wrong numbers, voicemails, and single-line billing/TC/logistics housekeeping. Those were excluded. What remains is a genuine but thin slice of real commercial conversation, so this KB is grounded strictly in that slice — rates, objections and lines quoted below are real lines said in those calls, not inferred.

## Products & brand ladder
BSC is a **steel stockist/distributor + processor** (cutting, slitting) dealing mainly in:
- **TMT rebar**: Fe500 / 500D / 550D grades; brands referenced — Sale (RINL/Vizag), Vaisakh, JSW, Sail, Jindal. Note from a call: "550 வராது sir sale-ல 500D தான் manufacture ஆகும்" [550 won't come; Sale brand only makes 500D] — RNL/Vizag was the only mill still rolling 500D/550D at the time ("R&L production இல்ல 3 months-ஆ").
- **CRS (cold-rolled sections / coil-related items)** — limited SKUs, e.g. "only 20 and 32 இது 2 item தான் இருக்கு."
- **MS Plates / Checkered plates** — thickness range 2mm–45mm, standard sheet sizes 4x8, 2.5x5/5x10/6300mm coils, cut-to-size on request (coil cutting in-house).
- **Structurals**: ISMB, ISMC, I/C channels, L-angles, square/rectangle pipes, flats (25mm, 50x5, 100x6 etc.), SHS ("SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல" — not dealt in).
- **Round bar / TMT for bolt-thread rolling** (sold in 12m lengths; no cut-to-size on TMT: "TMT-ல நம்ம 6 meter எப்பவுமே கொடுக்கலையே").
- Brand hierarchy repeatedly surfaces as **Sale (Vizag/RINL) ≈ Vaisakh** on price, but customers push for Sale specifically; NMDC appears for plates.
- Company also runs **in-house coil cutting/slitting** (seen in the Yuvraj Operator ops calls) — relevant to sales only as a lead time/quality constraint ("diagonal," "thickness," "wrinkled," "line mark" are QC terms customers raise).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- 20 mm Sale CRS: **₹69,000** quoted, "that's loading extra" but negotiable free loading for a customer.
- TMT 12 mm: **₹69**, 16 mm: **₹68.5**, both **"+GST extra"** (not inclusive) — quoted to Saveetha Institute enquiry.
- Structural plate/TMT market commentary: "TMT எல்லாம் 62, 63... Structural plate-லாம் 65, 66" (Odisha/DMD comparison call); another call: "66+ tax... 8,10-ல கொஞ்சம் ஜாஸ்தி."
- Zetwork Harish negotiation thread: base **63.5 → 63 → 62** per kg pushed down over calls; "₹500 discount" standard move; "loading extra தான் Sir வரும்."
- 6 mm plate (8x4): **₹66 + GST**, loading/transport extra, "proper quotation" sent only via WhatsApp, not phone.
- 8x4/20x4 5mm plate: **₹67 + GST**.
- Checkered/plate rates discussed with Vinayaga Steel Pradeep over weeks: "61.5, 61... 2mm 63 வருது," later "64 → 63.5," "rate increase ஆயிருக்கு... ₹1000 கிட்ட increase."
- Cash-and-Carry vs Credit: one dealer explicitly refuses to cut CnC rate — "Cash and Carry தான் நான் எல்லாருக்குமே கொடுத்துருக்கேன்." Credit term seen elsewhere: **"1 month தான்"** credit, with price slightly higher than advance-payment rate.
- Handling/payment charges: **₹200 standard** handling charge mentioned as non-negotiable company policy ("₹200 standard தான் போட்டுருக்கோம்").
- Transport (market/trailer rates quoted in various calls):
  - Trichy–Thuvakudi, 15–16 ton: **₹1800**
  - Gudur/Nayudupettai, 10 ton: **₹18** (per unit as quoted)
  - Vizag plant to Vellore/Katpadi: ~**26** (thousand, approx, for ~40–41 ton load)
  - Raichur–Chennai: **₹2100–2150**; Hyderabad same; Vizag: **₹2050**
  - Sangeetha Traders 40ft trailer: "₹15,000 வாடகை" quoted by a transporter, customer confirms this is standard for that length.
- Minimum vehicle load capacity cited: "minimum 5–6 ton வண்டிதான் இருக்கு, 7 ton வரைக்கும் ஏத்தலாம்."
- Cutting policy: Flats are **not** cut to length ("Flats-லாம் நம்ம cut பண்றது கிடையாது"); angles can be cut but attract an **extra vehicle/cutting charge, "₹5 per ton"** mentioned once.
- New-customer quantity policy: small quantities declined for first-time/new buyers — "
